name: The circle and the crossing tours
lesson: With cities evenly spaced on a circle the best tour is the circle itself, in order, and it crosses itself nowhere; random tours cross themselves many times and the search takes the crossings out.
lookFor: With this seed all 20 tours of the starting population cross themselves (between 12 and 42 crossings each); the best tour of the generation has 12 crossings at generation 0, 8 at generation 10, 4 at 20, 2 at 30 and 1 at 40, and at generation 46 Run until stop pauses within ε of the optimum: the tour is 1 2 3 … 15 and has no crossing. Over seeds 1 to 30 all 30 runs reach the optimum, between generation 28 and generation 84.
